model.name: Referential integrity — every ref resolves in the tree it is committed to (write-side dual of R37.1; carry-complete-or-fail-loud)
model.description: REFERENTIAL-INTEGRITY guard = the WRITE-side dual of R37.1's read-side fail-closed. ANY ref a unit carries — sprint.tasks[], ownerIor, parent/child, coveredRequirements, useCases, or any chain link — that does NOT RESOLVE IN THE TREE IT IS COMMITTED TO is RED. A single-tree orphan-audit (R27.4/R40.43) MISSES the cross-branch/partial-carry class because the ref resolves on the OTHER branch: this session's 47-tasks-invisible incident + the 4 cross-branch chains (units on main, tasks/markers/gates on hotfix) are that class. Enforced BOTH (a) as a DATA-CARRY gate — a cross-branch/tree carry is referentially COMPLETE (every carried ref resolves in the TARGET tree) or FAILS LOUD, never a silent partial-carry; AND (b) in ci:gates (trace-audit family) — a committed tree with a ref that doesn't resolve in-tree => RED. Repairing the individual dangling units leaves the CAUSE (incomplete carry) alive — this kills the cause. Doctrine: DISCOVERED-not-hand-listed (glob every ref-bearing unit), STUB-MUST-FAIL (plant a dangling ref -> RED), STATED==IMPLEMENTED.

acceptanceCriteria.text: ANY ref a unit carries (sprint.tasks[], ownerIor, parent, children, coveredRequirements, useCases, class/method/implementations/tests, any chain link) MUST resolve to an existing unit IN THE TREE THE REF IS COMMITTED TO. A ref that resolves only on another branch/tree => RED (referential-integrity violation).

gateRef.assertion: every ref in a committed tree resolves to a unit present in THAT tree; a ref resolving only cross-branch => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126): plant a ref to a uuid absent from the committed tree (present only on another branch) => RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: The WRITE/CARRY side dual of R37.1 (read fails closed): a cross-branch/cross-tree CARRY is referentially COMPLETE — every ref of every carried unit resolves in the TARGET tree — or it FAILS LOUD. NEVER a silent partial-carry (the 47-tasks-invisible + cross-branch-chain shape). The carry either brings the whole referential closure or reports exactly which refs would dangle.

gateRef.assertion: a carry that would leave any carried unit's ref unresolved in the target tree => FAILS LOUD (names the dangling refs), never silent-partial

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126): seed a partial carry (unit carried, its ref-target left behind) => fails loud naming the dangling ref; complete carry => admissible

acceptanceCriteria.text: Enforced in ci:gates as part of the trace-audit family: the audit resolves EVERY ref-bearing unit's refs against the committed tree and REDs on any in-tree-unresolvable ref. Report-only-loud first if a baseline of debt exists, strict when the offender count reaches 0 (R40.43 delta-gate precedent).

gateRef.assertion: ci:gates fails on any in-tree-unresolvable ref (report-only->strict at 0 per R40.43 precedent)

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126): seed a committed tree with an in-tree-dangling ref => ci:gates RED (or counted debt in report-only phase)

acceptanceCriteria.text: The ref-bearing unit set + the ref-field set are DISCOVERED by glob/structural scan (every unit, every ref field), NEVER a hand-maintained list — a new unit-type or a new ref field cannot silently escape the guard (a hand-list rots exactly like the artifacts it polices, R40.55 owner-list lesson). A ref-bearing shape present but not evaluated => flagged.

gateRef.assertion: ref-bearing units + ref fields discovered structurally; a ref-bearing unit/field absent from the evaluated set => flagged; a hand-list => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126): add a new ref field/unit-type absent from the evaluated set => flagged (not silent-pass)

acceptanceCriteria.text: STUB-MUST-FAIL (prove-the-prover): plant a dangling ref (a ref to a uuid not in the committed tree) => the guard REDs; remove/weaken the guard => the suite REDs. A referential-integrity guard that cannot go RED on a real dangling ref certifies nothing.

gateRef.assertion: planted dangling ref => RED; weakened guard => suite RED; a fully-resolved tree => GREEN

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126): the guard's own stub (planted dangling ref) observed RED before it counts as wired

acceptanceCriteria.text: STATED==IMPLEMENTED: the guard's scope as written (all listed ref kinds, both the data-carry gate AND the ci:gate) equals what the code enforces — no ref kind claimed-covered but unchecked, no gate half stated but not wired. (Guards against the reminder-not-mechanism / false-coverage class.)

gateRef.assertion: every ref-kind + both enforcement halves stated in this req are actually enforced; a claimed-but-unchecked ref-kind => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126): seed a ref-kind listed in scope but not enforced by the guard => RED (stated!=implemented)
